fomod.Name: Delectatio et Dominium

fomod.Description:
Bedroom drama for SkyrimNet - unified LLM-driven interaction scenes and solo posing, with real per-module install toggles: Baka Interactions, GS Poses, Cum Detection, FHU Inflation, SlaveTats degradation sets, and the Acheron downed-state bridge behind one MCM.
Requirements: see the README - every module is inert without its prerequisite, and nothing breaks in any combination.
